description: This source file implements serialization and deserialization logic for Web requests and responses, including handling of HTTP headers, content types, encoding, chunked transfer, and WebSocket extensions. It defines classes and methods for converting internal data structures to and from wire format, managing state during parsing, and handling compression and signature data.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request with methods for serialization and deserialization, managing headers, body, and request parameters.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with methods for serialization and deserialization, managing headers, status codes, and body.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the request or response object into a byte stream suitable for network transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Parses incoming byte stream data into structured request or response objects.

methods.name: ParseContentType
methods.description: Parses the Content-Type header to extract MIME type and character set.

methods.name: ToSignature
methods.description: Converts a signature object into its string representation.

methods.name: FromSignature
methods.description: Parses a string into a signature object.

methods.name: ToAuthorization
methods.description: Converts a string into an Authorization object.

methods.name: FromAuthorization
methods.description: Converts an Authorization object into its string representation.

methods.name: EndsWithCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix, case-insensitive.

methods.name: MIMETypeAndEncodingForFile
methods.description: Determines MIME type and encoding based on file extension and path.
